evals.prompt: Who's on call this week across our teams?
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the skill, loads the team registry from templates/icm-oncall-config.md, scrapes each team's current on-call Primary engineer from the IcM portal via Playwright, stores rows in the local table, and prints a clean per-team PE table.
assertions: Agent loads the team registry from templates/icm-oncall-config.md (one teamId per IcM request)
Agent navigates the IcM portal current on-call view via the Playwright browser
Agent returns a per-team table of Primary engineers
Agent flags teams with no schedule rather than erroring out

evals.prompt: Give me the on-call list including backup engineers.
evals.expected_output: Agent scrapes both Primary and Backup roles by adjusting the role filter and presents both per team.
assertions: Agent scrapes the Backup role in addition to Primary
Agent presents Primary and Backup per team

evals.prompt: Open an IcM incident for a specific team from the registry.
evals.expected_output: Agent should NOT use this skill — creating incidents / paging / editing schedules is out of scope. This skill only reads the current on-call list.
assertions: Agent does not attempt to create an incident with this skill
Agent clarifies the skill only retrieves the current on-call PE list
